team.heading: Team Members
team.lead: Manage your workspace collaborators and their access levels.

empty.title: No members found
empty.description: Try changing the role filter to see more results.

changeRole.title: Change role
changeRole.noRoles: No roles are available for your account to assign. If this looks wrong, try again signed in as a higher-level administrator.
changeRole.footnote: This change takes effect immediately. The user keeps their session until next request.

editAccount.title: Edit account
editAccount.googleEmailNotice: This account signs in with Google. Changing the email will disconnect Google sign-in for this account.
editAccount.footnote: Only name and email can be changed here. Use Change role to update access.

deleteUser.title: Delete user
deleteUser.description: Permanently delete {name} ({email})? This cannot be undone.
deleteUser.demoNotice: This is the demo account. After deletion you may need to re-provision demo data.
deleteUser.footnote: The account and related access are removed immediately.
